CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.

3. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   B. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

5. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

7. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   B. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

9. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

10. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

12. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
